entities.name: PTH-LV mass after AVR
observations: In 195 patients assessed 8 ± 3.5 years after AVR, circulating PTH was independently associated with higher LV mass index (p=0.003) and LV hypertrophy (p=0.02); procedure modality was unspecified in the retrieved abstract.

In 88 hemodialysis patients following AVR, higher preoperative PTH predicted less LV mass regression at about 28 ± 4 months: PTH ≥100 versus <100 pg/mL, regression 61 ± 75 versus 108 ± 49 g (p<0.0001); adjusted β=0.23, p=0.02.
Evidence supports association after AVR overall but does not establish a TAVR-specific relationship.
